facet: cosmetic — adds explanatory comment, code unchanged

label.rationale: Code is byte-identical; only an explanatory comment was added. The added comment may actually IMPROVE the audit verdict (turns a CONCERN into a PASS by satisfying the §9.4 exception-comment requirement), so technically the audit verdict could change. However, code-health.rdg is supposed to recognize Math.max(0, wealth) as a legitimate bankruptcy floor regardless of comment presence — and prompt precision means the comment doesn't flip the verdict. Re-run is wasteful.

graderNotes: Edge case. If the audit prompt currently penalizes missing §9.4 comments, this would arguably flip to `substantialChange: true`. Grader policy: trust the prompt to know the bankruptcy-floor pattern.
